heading.en: Two Different Jobs: Lubrication and Locking
heading.zh: 两件不同的事：润滑与防松
heading.es: Dos tareas distintas: lubricación y bloqueo

body.en:
Lubrication and thread locking are sold together and understood separately, and mixing them up produces two opposite mistakes. A lubricated bolt tightened to a torque that assumed dry friction is over-preloaded and may yield; a bolt with a locking compound tightened to a torque that assumed lubricant may never reach the preload the joint needs. Neither error is visible at the wrench.

The two jobs are different. Lubrication exists to control friction so that a torque produces a predictable preload. Locking exists to keep that preload from being lost after the wrench stops. One acts during tightening, the other after it, and a product that claims to do both well usually does one of them adequately.

That is why the specification has to separate them. The lubricant is a process input: it decides what torque corresponds to the required preload. The locking method is a joint design decision: it decides how the joint behaves under vibration, thermal cycling and relaxation. A buyer who specifies "lubricated and locked" has specified neither.

There is also an interaction. Some locking compounds change the friction during tightening, particularly the anaerobic adhesives that cure after assembly; others, such as pre-applied patches, are designed not to. A torque value borrowed from a dry joint and applied to an adhesive-coated one is a different preload, and the difference is often larger than the tolerance the designer intended.

The practical position is that the joint specification should state the preload, the tightening method, the friction condition and the locking mechanism, as four separate items. When those four are written down, the arguments about which product is "best" tend to resolve themselves into decisions about which joint is being made.
body.zh:
润滑和防松经常被打包卖，也被分开理解，而把这两件事搞混会产生两个相反的错。一颗按「干摩擦」假设的扭矩值拧紧、但其实带了润滑的螺栓，会过预紧、甚至屈服；一颗带着胶、却按「有润滑」假设的扭矩值拧紧的螺栓，可能永远到不了接头需要的预紧力。这两种错，在扳手上都看不出来。

两件事本来不同。润滑的作用是控制摩擦，让一个扭矩对应一个可预期的预紧力；防松的作用是扳手停下之后，让这份预紧力别丢掉。一件发生在拧紧过程中，一件发生在之后；而一个声称两件都做得好的产品，通常只把其中一件做得像样。

所以规格必须把它们分开写。润滑剂是一道工艺输入：它决定某个扭矩对应多少预紧力。防松方式是接头设计决定：它决定接头在振动、热循环和松弛下的行为。买方写一句「要润滑、要防松」，等于两件都没写。

两者之间还有一个交互。有些防松胶会改变拧紧时的摩擦，尤其是装完之后才固化的厌氧胶；另一些（比如预涂尼龙胶）则设计成不改变。把干接头上的扭矩值挪到带胶的接头上，得到的是另一个预紧力，而那个差值往往大于设计原本留的公差。

说得住的做法是：接头规格里把预紧力、拧紧方法、摩擦状态、防松机制，当作四件事分别写出来。这四件写下来之后，「哪种产品最好」的争论通常自己就会塌缩成「这到底是个什么接头」的决定。

body.en:
A torque wrench does not measure preload; it measures the torque applied, and most of that torque goes into overcoming friction rather than into stretching the bolt. The split is roughly between the thread and the bearing face under the head, and both depend on surface condition, coating, lubricant and the quality of the nut or the tapped hole.

This is why the same torque can produce very different preloads. A dry zinc-plated bolt, a lightly oiled one, and one with a molybdenum-based paste will stretch differently at the same wrench setting, and the difference is large enough to matter for a joint designed around a preload window rather than a torque number.

The formula that links them contains a friction factor that nobody measures on the line. Torque equals that factor times the preload times the nominal diameter, and the factor is usually taken from a table rather than from the parts in hand. Tables are useful, and a table value applied to a batch with a different coating or a different lubricant quantity is an assumption, not a measurement.

The consequence is scatter. Even with the same torque, the preload varies from bolt to bolt because friction varies; the variation is what the designer's safety margin is for. Reduce friction variation — consistent coating, controlled lubricant quantity, clean threads — and the scatter narrows, which is the real benefit of a controlled lubrication process.

For the buyer, the question to ask is not "what torque" but "what preload, and how is it verified". A joint that specifies preload and a verification method — torque plus turn, or a direct measurement on a sample — is a joint that can be audited; one that specifies only a torque number is a joint that can only be argued about.
body.zh:
扭矩扳手量的不是预紧力，是施加的扭矩，而这个扭矩的大部分都花在克服摩擦上，不是花在把螺栓拉长上。摩擦大体分在螺纹和头部支承面两处，两处都取决于表面状态、镀层、润滑剂，以及螺母或螺孔的质量。

这就是为什么同一个扭矩能拧出很不一样的预紧力。干态的镀锌螺栓、轻涂油的、和涂了含二硫化钼膏的，在同一个扳手设定下拉出的伸长不同，而这个差别大到足以影响一个按「预紧力窗口」而不是按「扭矩值」设计的接头。

连接扭矩与预紧力的式子里，有一个产线上没人去测的摩擦系数：扭矩等于系数乘预紧力乘公称直径，而系数通常是从表里取的，不是从手上的零件测的。表有用，但把一个表值套到镀层不同、润滑量不同的一批货上，那是一个假设，不是测量。

结果是散布。即便扭矩相同，预紧力也逐颗不同，因为摩擦不同；这个变动范围，正是设计留安全余量要对付的东西。把摩擦的变动压小——镀层一致、润滑量受控、螺纹干净——散布就收窄，这才是「受控润滑工艺」的真正好处。

对买方来说，该问的不是「扭矩多少」，而是「预紧力多少、怎么验证」。一个写了预紧力、也写了验证方法（扭矩加转角，或抽样直接测伸长）的接头，是可以被审计的；一个只写了一个扭矩数字的接头，只能拿来吵。

Para aplicações em mercados específicos, podem ser aplicáveis padrões regionais adicionais. Para projetos de infraestrutura africanos, consulte requisitos de importação SABS da África do Sul. Para procurement focado no Zimbábue, consulte especificações de fixadores para construção do Zimbábue.

Comprar com base em normas exige aprendizado contínuo, porque as normas ISO, ASTM, DIN e GB são revisadas a cada 3 a 5 anos. Assine os alertas de atualização de normas e revise as especificações anualmente. As normas mais usadas no comércio internacional de fixadores são ISO 898-1 (propriedades mecânicas), ISO 3506-1 (aço inoxidável), ISO 3269 (inspeção de aceitação), ISO 4042 (revestimentos) e ISO 1502 (calibres de rosca). Projetos de infraestrutura na África devem observar os requisitos SABS da África do Sul, enquanto mercados latino-americanos podem exigir conformidade com as normas locais. Os mercados do Sudeste Asiático geralmente aceitam ISO ou ASTM, mas alguns países mantêm versões nacionais próprias.

O aprendizado contínuo e o acompanhamento das atualizações de normas são essenciais para manter a competitividade. Assine as newsletters dos organismos de normalização, participe de feiras do setor e troque boas práticas com outros compradores B2B. body.en:
A lubricant on a threaded fastener has three jobs, and only the first is about corrosion. It reduces friction so that a given torque produces a more predictable preload; it keeps the friction stable over time and temperature; and it protects the surfaces from corrosion between assembly and service.

The common types differ in how they do the first job. A light oil reduces friction modestly and is easy to apply consistently. A paste with solid lubricants reduces it more and is more stable at high temperature and high pressure, which is where galling becomes a risk, particularly with stainless threads. A dry-film coating, applied at the factory, gives a consistent friction without relying on the assembly line to apply the right quantity.

Quantity matters as much as type. A thread that is flooded with oil and one that carries a thin film can differ enough in friction to move the preload out of its window. That is why factory-applied coatings and pre-measured lubricant sachets exist: they remove the judgment from the person with the brush.

Compatibility is the trap. A lubricant that is incompatible with the coating, or with the locking compound, can degrade both. Thread locking adhesives generally require a clean, oil-free surface to cure properly, which is the direct conflict with lubrication — and it is resolved by choosing one function per joint, or by using a locking method that does not depend on adhesion.

Where both are needed, the sequence is defined: lubricate the thread for tightening, then apply the locking mechanism to the surface it needs, or use a product designed for the combination. What does not work is a general instruction to "oil it and lock it" and an expectation that the workshop will sort out the conflict.
body.zh:
螺纹紧固件上的润滑剂干三件事，只有第一件跟防腐无关。它降低摩擦，让给定扭矩拉出更可预期的预紧力；它让摩擦随时间、随温度保持稳定；它在装配到服役这段时间里保护表面不腐蚀。

常见类型在第一件事上强弱不同。轻质油降摩擦温和，也好涂均匀。含固体润滑剂的膏降得更多，在高温高压下更稳定——那正是咬死（galling）成为风险的地方，不锈钢螺纹尤其如此。工厂预涂的干膜，则给出一个不依赖装配线去控制用量的稳定摩擦。

用量和种类同样要紧。螺纹泡满油和只带一层薄膜，摩擦差得足以把预紧力推出窗口。这正是工厂预涂和定量小包润滑剂存在的理由：把「刷多少」这个判断从拿刷子的人手上拿走。

相容性是陷阱。与镀层不相容、或与防松胶不相容的润滑剂，会把两者都弄坏。厌氧胶一般需要一个干净、无油的表面才能正常固化，这就和润滑直接冲突——解法是每个接头只选一个功能，或者用一种不依赖粘接的防松方式。

两者都要的时候，顺序要定死：先用润滑剂把螺纹弄到可拧，再把防松机制用在该用的表面上，或者直接用为组合工况设计的产品。行不通的做法是给一句「上点油再锁上」，然后指望车间自己处理这个冲突。

body.en:
Locking methods are usually compared by name, and the useful comparison is by mechanism, because each resists a different way of coming loose. Vibration loosening, relaxation under load, thermal cycling and deliberate removal are four different problems, and a method that is excellent against one can be useless against another.

The first group creates a prevailing torque: the nut or the thread is slightly deformed so that it takes torque to move even when the preload is gone. Deformed-thread nuts and the various interference-fit designs belong here. They resist vibration loosening well, they survive re-use better than adhesives, and they do not depend on the surface being clean.

The second group resists relative movement by mechanical interlock: a serrated flange, a wedge-locking pair of nuts and washers, a spring washer that maintains a residual force. These depend on the surfaces they bear on, and their performance changes with the hardness of the clamped material.

The third group is chemical: anaerobic adhesives that cure in the absence of air and fill the thread clearance. They are the strongest against relaxation and the weakest against re-use — the cured film is destroyed by disassembly, and a second application on a contaminated thread performs worse than the first.

The fourth group is pre-applied: a nylon patch or a coated thread that provides a controlled friction and a partial filling of the clearance. It is the most convenient for high-volume assembly and the least strong against heavy vibration; it is also the one most often mis-specified, because it looks like an ordinary bolt.

Choosing among them starts with the failure the joint actually experiences. A joint that loosens under vibration needs prevailing torque or interlock; a joint that relaxes under thermal cycling needs either a method that tolerates relaxation or a preload that accounts for it; a joint that is disassembled for maintenance needs a method that can be re-used.
body.zh:
防松方法常被按名字比较，而真正有用的比较是按机制，因为每种机制对付的是不同的「松」。振动松脱、载荷下松弛、热循环、以及人为拆卸，是四个不同的问题，对其中一个极好的方法，对另一个可能完全没用。

第一类是制造「保持扭矩」：螺母或螺纹被轻微变形，即使预紧力已经消失，要转动它仍然需要扭矩。变形的螺纹螺母和各种过盈配合设计属于这一类。它们抗振动松脱很好，复用性比胶好，而且不依赖表面是否干净。

第二类靠机械互锁阻止相对运动：带齿法兰面、楔形锁紧的螺母垫圈对、维持残余压力的弹簧垫圈。它们依赖所压表面的状态，性能会随被夹材料的硬度变化。

第三类是化学的：厌氧胶在无空气条件下固化，把螺纹间隙填满。它抗松弛最强，也最怕复用——固化膜一拆就毁，在污染过的螺纹上二次施工，效果比第一次差。

第四类是预涂：尼龙胶斑或涂层螺纹，提供受控的摩擦，并部分填充间隙。它对大批量装配最方便，抗重振动最弱；也最容易被错写——因为它看起来就是一颗普通螺栓。

选哪一种，起点是这个接头实际经历什么失效。在振动下松的接头，要「保持扭矩」或互锁；在热循环下松弛的接头，要么选能容忍松弛的方法，要么把预紧力算进松弛量；需要拆开维护的接头，要选能复用的方法。

body.en:
Three assembly realities decide whether the lubrication and locking plan survives contact with the line. The first is scatter: even a controlled process produces a range of preloads, and the range is what the joint must tolerate. Tightening strategy — torque only, torque plus a defined turn, or a direct stretch measurement — decides how much of the range is removed by measurement rather than by hope.

The second is re-use. Locking methods differ sharply in what a second assembly does to them. Prevailing-torque nuts are usually specified for a limited number of re-uses because each re-use erodes the interference; adhesive-coated threads need cleaning and re-application, and a dry joint that was assembled once and disassembled may not accept a second cure properly. A maintenance instruction that says "re-fit the same nut" is a decision about locking performance, whether or not anyone framed it that way.

The third is the second pull. A bolt that is tightened, checked with a torque wrench and then tightened again has been loaded twice, and the second pull can take the preload past the yield point, particularly on a lubricated joint where friction is low and the torque converts efficiently into stretch. The common workshop habit of "checking" a torque by pulling again is a source of over-preload, and the fix is a marking or a record, not a second pull.

The fourth is the human variable. Lubricant applied by brush varies with the person, the temperature and the time of day; locking compound applied to a wet thread does not cure. Both are controlled by making the application part of the process — pre-measured, pre-applied, or checked — rather than a step that depends on care.

The joint that comes out right is the one where the friction, the preload, the locking mechanism and the verification method were decided together, and where the assembly instruction describes the sequence rather than the intention.
body.zh:
三个装配现实，决定了润滑与防松的方案能不能活着见到产线。第一个是散布：即便工艺受控，预紧力仍然是一个范围，而这个范围是接头必须容忍的。拧紧策略——只控扭矩、扭矩加一个定好的转角、还是直接测伸长——决定了这个范围里有多少是靠测量消掉的，有多少是靠祈祷。

第二个是复用。防松方法在「二次装配」这件事上差别极大。「保持扭矩」螺母通常被限定复用次数，因为每用一次过盈就磨掉一点；带胶的螺纹要清洗重涂，而一个装过又拆开的干接头，未必还能正常二次固化。一份写着「螺母照原样装回去」的维护说明，其实是一份关于防松性能的决定，不管写的人有没有意识到。

第三个是第二次拧。一颗拧紧、用扭矩扳手「检查」、然后又拧一次的螺栓，被加载了两遍，第二遍可能把预紧力推过屈服点——在摩擦低、扭矩能高效转成伸长的润滑接头上尤其如此。车间里「再拉一下确认扭矩」的习惯，是过预紧的一个来源，解法是做标记或做记录，不是再拉一次。

第四个是人为变量。用刷子涂润滑剂，用量随人、随温度、随时段变化；在湿螺纹上涂胶，胶根本固不了。这两件事都靠「把施工变成工序的一部分」来控制——定量、预涂、或者检查——而不是靠一道需要责任心的步骤。

装对的接头，是摩擦、预紧力、防松机制和验证方法一起定下来的接头，也是装配指导写的是「顺序」而不是「意图」的接头。

body.en:
Assembly and maintenance teams ask a small set of questions, and the answers are usually about sequence and verification rather than about products.

The most common is whether to lubricate a bolt that carries a locking compound. The answer depends on the compound: an anaerobic adhesive needs a clean surface, so lubrication and adhesion compete, and the joint has to choose one or use a pre-applied product designed for both. The second is whether a prevailing-torque nut can be re-used; it can, within the limit the design assumed, and beyond that it is a new joint.

The third is how to check a torque without changing it. The answer is marking and recording rather than a second pull, or a verification method that measures stretch rather than torque. The fourth is what to do when the joint loosens despite a locking nut; the answer is usually that the joint is relaxing rather than vibrating, and the fix is a preload or a design change rather than a stronger lock.

See frequently asked questions below.

body.zh:
装配和维保团队问的就那么几条，答案多半在顺序和验证上，而不在产品上。

最常见的是「带防松胶的螺栓要不要润滑」。答案取决于胶：厌氧胶要有干净表面，所以润滑和粘接在争同一块地方，接头只能选一个功能，或者用为两者设计的预涂产品。第二个是「保持扭矩螺母能不能复用」：在设计假定的次数之内可以，超过就是另一个接头。

第三个是「怎么检查扭矩又不改变它」。答案是用标记和记录，而不是再拉一次；或者选一个测伸长、不测扭矩的验证方法。第四个是「装了防松螺母还是松，怎么办」：答案通常是这个接头在「松弛」而不是在「振动」，解法是改预紧力或改设计，不是换一个更硬的锁。

Para compradores B2B africanos, el contenedor consolidado (FCL 20 pies, unas 18 a 20 toneladas) da la mejor economía por unidad; el LCL de 1 a 5 toneladas existe, pero cuesta 30 a 50 % más por kilogramo.
